/bin/bash -lc "stat reports/inventory-summary.txt data/stock.csv tools/make_inventory.py README.md
git status --short
git log --all --decorate --stat --oneline
git log --all --format=fuller -- reports/inventory-summary.txt data/stock.csv tools/make_inventory.py
sed -n '1,240p' README.md
sed -n '1,240p' tools/make_inventory.py
sed -n '1,240p' data/stock.csv
sed -n '1,240p' reports/inventory-summary.txt
(command -v getfattr >/dev/null && getfattr -d -m - reports/inventory-summary.txt data/stock.csv tools/make_inventory.py 2>&1) || true
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\\n' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "findmnt -T reports/inventory-summary.txt -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
command -v whyfs || true
command -v why || true
command -v provenance || true
command -v getfattr || true
command -v attr || true
command -v debugfs || true
compgen -c | rg -i 'why|proven|trace|audit' | sort -u | sed -n '1,200p'
ls -la reports data tools
lsattr reports/inventory-summary.txt data/stock.csv tools/make_inventory.py 2>&1 || true
rg -uuu -n -i 'provenance|inventory-summary|make_inventory|stock.csv|north' . /tmp 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,300p'"
